name: Galápagos sea lion
desc: Eats mainly sardines plus squid, octopus and crustaceans. Sharks hunt it, and its numbers fall when El Niño drives away its prey.
about: The Galápagos sea lion is a species of sea lion that lives and breeds on the Galápagos Islands and, in smaller numbers, on Isla de la Plata (Ecuador). They are the smallest sea lion species.
